d: President Donald Trump’s administration has proposed a new wave of Section 301 tariffs targeting 14 major economies—including India, China, and the European Union putting up to 25% tariffs on India without a trade deal, or 17% with a deal. In this episode of Rajdoot, Khabargaon’s daily international bulletin, Nikhil breaks down what the USTR investigation claims about India’s manufacturing, PLI, and Make in India schemes, how India compares with Asian rivals, how New Delhi, Beijing, and the EU are pushing back, and what comes next ahead of the G20 summit and 2027 hearings.
